# Guide to the supporting code {#sec-app-code}

Every numerical or symbolic claim in this book that is not a textbook result is backed by a script in the repository [github.com/gustavdelius/affine_toda](https://github.com/gustavdelius/affine_toda). The scripts are Python 3 with numpy, scipy, sympy and mpmath (`requirements.txt`), and all of them are in the directory `code/`. Wherever the text names a script, the name links to its source.

The scripts directly in `code/` run on their own and print one `PASS` or `FAIL` line per check. They cover Parts I–IV, VII and VIII, appendix A and parts of Part IX. The larger computations are in subdirectories. Each of their scripts is run from its own directory, and most print tables or residuals, with the stored output next to them.

| Subdirectory | Parts | What it contains |
|---|---|---|
| `hirota/`, `oneloop/`, `thimbles/` | V | Hirota fluctuations, transmission factors and Jordan types; one-loop masses of all folded solitons; the thimble decomposition of the reduced model and topological charges |
| `rmatrix/` | VI, appendix B | Construction of representations and R-matrices of quantum affine algebras from their defining relations, scalar factors, fusion, pole scans and breather tests for $c_n^{(1)}$, $a_{2n-1}^{(2)}$, $e_6^{(2)}$, $f_4^{(1)}$, $g_2^{(1)}$ and $d_4^{(3)}$, and the one-loop comparisons with the Toda Lagrangian |
| `vernier/`, `irf/`, `sectors/` | VI, IX | The lattice model of Vernier, Jacobsen and Saleur; RSOS face weights of $a_2^{(1)}$; Krein unitarity and the classification of multi-soliton sectors |
| `review614/` | IX | Random tests of the continuum-limit lemmas |
| `figures/` | all | Scripts that draw the figures and check the formulas they plot |

`code/README.md` is the index of the scripts. It says what each script checks and names the statements it checks by their ids. It gives the runtimes of the scripts directly in `code/`, lists the Part V scripts of the subdirectories one by one, and lists the figure scripts with the formulas they check. `code/rmatrix/README.md` describes the scripts of Part VI.
